_comment: §12 S1 real-failure fixture — banked as T3 regression corpus (AC-65.3)
description: getTransaction returned a full tx dict with a non-null meta.err. The outer transaction was included in a block but the inner instruction execution failed (e.g. InsufficientFunds, or an unmapped Anchor error). The tx consumed network fees. Must be treated as confirmation failure — not as a successful send. The decoded error is logged for diagnosis. This is Phase 3 meta.err verification (2026-05-13).
notes: meta.err is present on both buy and sell paths. A non-null meta.err on a buy means no Position is created. On a sell it means the retry loop should attempt the next sell. The raw meta.err is always logged so unmapped codes remain diagnosable.
